scene: The pulled goldfish kite drops a shiny brass key!
picture: Flat pixel-art side view along the brick street. On the far left stands a padlocked iron alley gate. In the centre, the bearded elderly man in blue flat cap and orange cardigan leans on his wooden cane, looking at a small brass key lying on the ground. On the far right waits a bright yellow trolley with open doors.
shown: A rusted iron alley gate on the far left, secured with heavy chains.
A glinting brass key resting on the stone pavement at the centre.
A bright yellow trolley stopped on rails along the far right side.

variants.scene: A shimmering brass key clatters onto the cobblestones beneath the glowing fish.
The hanging lantern fish releases a shiny key onto the street below.
A bright key twinkles on the pavement near the locked alleyway.
